prompts.name: castle-cliffs
prompts.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. The attached image is the approved v6 composition and stippling style reference. Create ONLY layer 5, the cliffs and castle, for a browser-composited scene. Transparent PNG, full 1536x1024 canvas, same coordinates as reference: dark compact crenellated castle at x=1140 to1300,y=110 to310; castle gate and zigzag stone road down the cliff face; sheer cliff mass from x=900 to1536, bottom ending near y=655 (64% canvas height), a few attached pines allowed. Preserve the detailed fine monochrome stipple, black silhouette, moonlit white stone edges and dark cliff fissures. COMPLETE the castle geometry obscured by other objects, but KEEP its shape and position. Everything outside the castle/cliff silhouette must be truly transparent alpha, including the whole left half, all sky behind battlements and pines, the upper sky and lower water. Retain opaque BLACK interior shadows within the cliff and castle (black is part of the subject). No moon, stars, clouds, lake, reflection, background mountains, foreground tree, rocks, reeds, characters, UI or text. Do not render a composite scene or checkerboard; this is an isolated full-canvas registration-aligned cutout.

Keep v6's sharp mountain ridges, layered pine silhouettes, white stippled valley fog, and extremely fine 1985 Macintosh monochrome pen-and-ink texture. Composition: transparent sky for top 32% of canvas; jagged mountain tops roughly y=355 to460; forest bands around y=480 to620; misty horizontal distant lake shoreline at y=655. Below shoreline use opaque black fill to bottom (will be covered by separate water). All sky above the mountain silhouette must be genuine transparent alpha; internal mountain shadows and trees are opaque black. Do NOT include stars, moon, clouds, castle, cliff, path, lake surface, reflection, foreground tree, rocks, reeds, people, text, UI, or checkerboard. No fuzzy halo around the mountain contour. Preserve scale and horizon of the composition reference.

prompts.name: moon
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: standalone full moon for a finely stippled black-and-white 1985 Macintosh castle landscape. Produce a square 1024x1024 transparent PNG. Outside the circular moon is completely transparent alpha. No halo, outer glow, black disc behind it, stars, sky, clouds, scenery, architecture, text, border or checkerboard. prompts.name: ground-mist

prompts.name: clouds-bank
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: independent transparent background mist layer for a monochrome Macintosh castle scene, 1536x1024 PNG.
Input image: user's annotated exterior-v6 is a composition and texture REFERENCE ONLY. The red line marks the upper boundary of the desired broad mist bank. Do NOT include the red markup or any scenery.
Primary request: render ONLY the broad glowing bank of low ground mist behind the mountains. It fills substantial space, unlike thin horizontal wisps. Its upper contour starts around y=150 at the left, slopes down gently to y=350 near the center, then rises again to y=150 at the right. Below this contour mist grows denser and luminous white toward y=500–650. Above the contour is transparent empty sky. This is a WIDE connected atmospheric mass, with very soft ragged stippled upper edges, not individual puffy clouds, not stripes.
Style: fine black-and-white stippling and subtle diagonal hatch texture matching the reference. Sparse tiny white dots at upper edge, gradually dense white dots below; the density varies in slow broad patches. No photographic smoke, no Gaussian glow, no hard boundary line. Keep true transparent gaps between stipple dots; opaque white where mist is densest. Transparent alpha background, not opaque black. Lower area from y=700 to1024 can be transparent as it is hidden by independent mountain scenery.
Seamless horizontal tiling: left and right edge contours AND stipple density must match at the same heights, with no borders or vertical edge. Designed to repeat horizontally continuously. Maintain the full 1536x1024 registration canvas, do not crop tightly around the bank.
Avoid: moon, stars, mountains, forests, trees, castle, cliffs, water, land, foreground, any text, red marks, checkerboard. Output cloud/mist layer ONLY.
prompts.revision: Broad mist bank following annotated v6 cloud boundary; cloud-only follow-up after cdfce88.

prompts.name: clouds-hatched
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent atmospheric background layer, full 1536x1024 canvas.
Input references: IMAGE 1 is the TARGET TEXTURE (the v6 mountain crop). IMAGE 2 is the REJECTED cloudy speckle texture. Match IMAGE 1 only.
Primary request: draw only the luminous low mist BEHIND the mountain ridges in image 1. Reconstruct it unobstructed across the canvas. It is a flat engraved, hatched tone, NOT a naturalistic cloud. The texture near the mountain peaks is made of dense, crisp, parallel DIAGONAL strokes running bottom-left to top-right at 45 degrees, smoothly transitioning upward into fine sparse regular tiny dots and then transparency. In the target the hatching is clearly visible as many long fine parallel lines. This visual character is essential.
Composition: connected bank with upper sparse dotted contour at y=140 left edge, y=315 center, y=140 right edge. Dense luminous diagonal hatching reaches y=430 at center and y=380 at sides, continuing downward to y=680 (hidden behind mountains at runtime). Top third mostly empty transparency, with more transparent sky centrally. Lower edge may finish at y=720. Left and right edges same height and density for tiling.
Mark scale: delicate approximately 1-pixel engraved strokes spaced 3-4 pixels apart at output resolution, same angle throughout. Dots tiny 1px, not irregular white blobs. Above the hatched area, loose staggered tiny dots create the fade into empty sky. All blank gaps between white lines and dots genuinely transparent alpha, so a black sky shines through. White ink only; no cloudy gray pigment or opaque black backdrop.
DO NOT repeat the rejected asset's powdery blotches, coarse oval dots, fluffy cloud texture, blurred smoke, noisy granular gradients, lumps, swirls or bright cloudy knots. NO crosshatching or opposing diagonal angles. NO scenery: no mountain silhouettes, moon, stars, trees, castle, lake, land, text, checkerboard, frame, glow or color.
Output ONLY the hatched/dotted mist layer on genuine transparent alpha.
prompts.revision: Match v6 diagonal engraving and sparse dots instead of coarse cloud speckles.

prompts.name: clouds-hatched-final
prompts.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
The FIRST reference image is the correct v6 mountain crop. All later images are rejected attempts/comparisons. Reconstruct ONLY the bright mist immediately behind the mountains from that FIRST reference, extending it into an independent 1536x1024 transparent layer. Match its engraving texture closely.
Critical correction: the rejected latest attempt has large evenly spaced white diagonal stripes on dark gray. That is WRONG. The target has dense, VERY FINE irregular BLACK diagonal ink hatching over a BRIGHT WHITE mist body, with the white increasingly dominant toward the mountain ridges. Hatch spacing is approximately 2 pixels, black stroke around 1 pixel, many hundreds of closely packed fine parallel strokes. They must look hand-engraved, delicate and slightly interrupted, not a clean geometric stripe pattern. No thick stripes, no coarse dots, no dark gray smoke body.
The lower body of the mist is bright opaque white with tiny BLACK ink marks INSIDE it. It must NOT be semi-transparent gray. Only the UPPER edge transitions into alpha via sparse fine WHITE stipple/dashes on transparent sky. Dense white body remains opaque, including its black engraved marks. Upper edge fades softly and irregularly. This is a flat 1-bit-style illustration, no smooth gray atmospheric blur or glow.
Full-canvas registration: upper sparse edge begins y=140 at left, descends to y=320 at center and rises to y=140 at right. Fine hatching begins just below that edge and becomes predominantly white by y=420 at center. The bank extends down to y=680, where it can fade out because mountains will cover it. Empty sky and everything outside the bank genuinely transparent alpha.
No mountain shapes, trees, moon, stars, clouds with fluffy lobes, buildings, rocks, water, landscape objects, text, borders or checkerboards. Output only the unobstructed finely engraved luminous mist texture, ready for placing behind black mountain silhouettes.
prompts.revision: Selected: bright opaque mist with delicate black engraving; supersedes the dark striped draft.
